name: reconcile_watch_undated_bars_20261109
comment: LQ-1706: an undated bar source settled every due watch candidate as NOT_EVALUABLE, taking it out of the verdict IS NULL selector for good, while the run reported produced=N and exit 0. Such events are now a bars_unavailable skip that leaves the verdict NULL (retryable); a run where none could be scored exits 1 naming the bar source. An empty but datable series keeps its old NOT_EVALUABLE meaning.
